1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS – JEWEL SAFE Jewel Safes : No of shelves – 7; No of trays – 16; No. of drawers – 2; · Participating bidders should have a service centre in Karnataka. If the bidder does not submit proof of having a service centre in Karnataka, they will be disqualified. · The safe offered should be a Class BB Jewel Safe, TRTL-15x6. The dimensions and specifications must comply with IS 550 (Part I): 2014. · The OEM should have a minimum of 5 years' experience as on 31.03.2025 in the s upply of TRTL safes. · The OEM must submit financial statements for the last three financial years: 2022 –2023, 2023–2024, and 2024–2025. · The safe must carry an IS 550 listing mark as per BIS rules for TRTL-15x6 rating. T he BIS labelling must clearly indicate the manufacturer or brand name, class and r ating of the product, year of manufacture, IS number, and CML number allotted by BIS. · The safes required will be Class BB 1340 Single Door as per IS 550 (Part-I):2014. · The vendor must be the OEM for locks and must possess valid IS 17566 certificati ons. · Only authorized dealers of Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) are eligible. An authorization letter must be submitted on the OEM’s letterhead. · The OEM must hold a valid BIS license for all physical security equipment mention ed in the tender. If the BIS license for any applied product category expires before the process is completed, a renewed license must be submitted. Failure to do so w ill result in disqualification. · The safe offered should have a minimum weight of 1600 kg. · The OEM and/or authorized agent must give written consent to the Bank for rando m testing of the product at their own cost at a BIS-approved laboratory. They must also agree to replace the product to be tested with a new product of the same clas s before testing. All transportation and testing costs will be borne by the OEM/auth orized agent. This requirement will be at the exclusive discretion of the Bank. · Only experience with PSU Banks or Scheduled Commercial Banks will be consider ed. A copy of the purchase order along with the purchaser’s contact details must b e attached for verification.

· The vendor must provide a valid ISO certification. · The OEM must provide a declaration on its company letterhead stating that it has not been blacklisted or debarred in the last 3 years by any Government Departme nt, Financial Institution, Public Sector Unit, or Scheduled Commercial Bank in India. Only Empanelled vendors of Bank of Bar oda are eligible to participate in this ten der.
